notes.title: Changed to third-person view!
notes.content:
Hello!
If you don´t want to read this text take a look at the bottom for the change overview.

After we released the game to early access and hat some time to take a deeper look into how the game would look into a third-person view. We came fast to the conclusion that the game would benefit a lot from it! We have gone straight to work to change that. The old version is now moved to the Legacy Branch in case you want to see the difference.

Even if we now accomplished to make the swap, it's not over yet. The new controller still need some work and polishment, especially on the animation side. But we will take care about that within the next week. 

[b]What's up next?[/b]

We are currently investigating an option that might bring some bigger replayability to the game which on the downside would push chapter two back in the roadmap. But we think the game will benefit a lot from it and give you a long term goal between major updates. 

We will update on that topic as soon as we made a decision. 
Stay tuned! 




[b]CHANGES[/b]
- Changed from top-down view to a third-person view
- Changed post-processing 
- Overhauled Pirate Scene
- Added option to show and hide the cursor
- Added option to hide UI until the next UI Update
- Overhauled light in the museum

[b]TODO[/b]
- Add more detail to the museum 
- Research replay ability (Priority)
- Tweak some animations
-  Polish new third-person controller

Take care!
Social Anvil Team
